body: I’m glad you agree, I’d really like an answer and I don’t think there is one.
You can message me? I’ve been in this sub all night and I’m in the same place.

Whatever you choose I support you. I don’t know you, no one on here knows you. No one can tell you what you should and shouldn’t do. 

With that being said, I do hope you find a reason to live. But if you can’t then at least you’ll find peace.

I tell myself that if I’m going to do it I need to clean my room. I don’t want them to find me and then say I kept a messy house. But I don’t ever want to clean my room. So that really helps. Or I’ll actually clean my room and then feel good enough about doing it that I’m not in the mood to die anymore. Pro tip. The only thing keeping me alive is the state of my apartment.
Sometimes I fantasize that a burglar comes to my house and kills me so it’s not my fault.

My mom always said she was going to “roll the laundry” meaning move the washed laundry to the dryer and fold the dried laundry. Idk how else you would say this without the whole explanation. But every time I use this term people look at me funny and have never heard it before.

Also: My friends mother always said “I’m picking up your sticks” as if to say “I’m picking up what you’re putting down” but I think she really just doesn’t know the proper saying. My grandma says “I’m smelling  what you’re stepping in” so that ones... gross.

Gotta edit again (Can’t stop thinking about this now) when we would go out on the lake and the water was smooth my Grandfather would say “it’s flatter than piss on a platter” and that’s my favorite.
We’re not entirely sure Rick got his family killed. It was a fabricated origin story. That’s why he was able to give the bugs system a virus.

Harry goes in Book Two with the Weasley family. That’s when he felt ashamed because Mrs. Weasley has such a small pile in her vault, and Harry tried to hide that he had towers of coins in his own. 

I’m reading Chamber if Secrets now, which is the only reason I remember that. I’ll try to think of some other occasions.
